description: Walks a null-terminated string to its end, then makes two calls through library function pointers. It references the text Can't find.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:TEAM17:0:0000
name: run_entry_with_exec_calls
description: Program entry for the TEAM17 file, with the same body as the INSTALL entry: several routine calls, a call through a stored function pointer, a cleared memory slot, an exec FreeMem call and a return of two register values.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:TEAM17:0:0034
name: decrement_to_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit register value in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:0:0000
name: scan_list_and_allocate_handler
description: Scans a linked list for its largest value, then allocates a block sized from that maximum, fills it with a pattern of longwords, copies a sixteen-longword block into it and returns zero. It returns minus one when allocation fails.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0000
name: call_library_function_three_times
description: Writes zero through a pointer and calls a library function at a fixed offset, stores the returned value, and repeats this for two more table entries before returning zero.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:00C6
name: call_three_routines_return_zero
description: Calls three routines in turn and returns zero.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:00E6
name: store_four_results_to_globals
description: Calls one routine four times and stores each returned value in its own global slot, at four fixed offsets from a base register.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:011C
name: allocate_memory_with_offset
description: Calls the Amiga exec AllocMem function through a pointer. It returns zero when that call returns zero, and otherwise returns the result plus 32768.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:015A
name: poll_open_library_until_success
description: Repeatedly calls the Amiga exec OpenLibrary function through a pointer until it returns a nonzero result, then returns.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0186
name: forward_single_call
description: A wrapper that calls one routine and returns.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0190
name: copy_byte_buffer
description: Copies a byte sequence from a source to a destination, moving eight bytes at a time for large counts and the remaining bytes singly, then writes a zero terminator after the copied bytes.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:01DE
name: clear_globals_and_call
description: Clears two global variables to zero with a call in between and returns the address of its own routine.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:01F6
name: repeat_call_until_flag_set
description: Calls one routine repeatedly until its result sets the zero flag, then returns.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0200
name: allocate_linked_block_or_trap
description: Calls a function through a pointer to obtain a memory block, links the block into a list and returns its data address when the block is present. Otherwise it raises a processor trap, and the decoded body then stops at bad instruction data.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0204
name: unlink_or_allocate_list_entry
description: Walks a linked list for the entry it was given. On a match it unlinks the entry and calls a library function; otherwise it may allocate a new entry, and it raises a processor trap when allocation fails.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0210
name: find_list_tail
description: Follows a linked list through its pointers until it reaches a null entry, then stores the address of that final pointer in a global variable.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0224
name: save_restore_global_value
description: Saves the value of a global variable, calls two routines, then restores the saved value.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:023E
name: save_restore_global_value
description: Saves the value of a global variable, calls two routines, then restores the saved value.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0258
name: allocate_block_and_link
description: Allocates a block through the Amiga exec AllocMem function and, when the allocation succeeds, links the block into a list and returns its data address. Otherwise it calls one routine and raises a processor trap.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:028C
name: free_list_entry_via_exec
description: Searches a linked list for the given entry. When it finds it, it unlinks the entry and frees its memory through the Amiga exec FreeMem function. If the entry is not found, it attempts an allocation and raises a processor trap when that fails.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:02BA
name: unlink_entry_from_list
description: Walks a linked list to find the entry whose successor is the one being removed, then unlinks it and calls a library function. With no match it attempts an allocation and raises a processor trap on failure. It references a command-line text fragment ending in TEAM17.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:02D8
name: allocate_entry_and_push_list
description: Allocates a block through the Amiga exec AllocMem function, pushes it onto a list by storing the previous head and clearing its second word, and returns the block. If allocation fails, it raises a processor trap.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:1:0306
name: free_all_list_entries
description: Frees the head entry of a linked list through the Amiga exec FreeMem function, then frees each following entry in turn.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:2:0000
name: scan_list_and_install_handler
description: Scans a linked list for its largest value, allocates a block sized from that maximum, fills it with a longword pattern, copies a sixteen-longword block to and from a buffer, and stores the address of a handler routine in the block before returning zero. It returns minus one when allocation fails.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:FLOPPYWORM:2:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longwords_then_call
description: When its destination pointer is set, copies sixteen longwords from a source block into it, then calls a routine through a stored pointer.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:0000
name: stub_unimplemented_instruction
description: A single instruction that the decompiler reports as unimplemented, so the routine stops at once and no behaviour is recovered. It belongs to the mathtrans shared library on the disk, which is library code rather than game code.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:0058
name: store_address_in_global
description: Stores its address-register input in a library global and returns. A pointer in the library's data refers to it.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:00D4
name: release_library_node_if_idle
description: If a counter field in a library node is zero, it unlinks the node from its list, frees it through the Amiga exec FreeMem function and returns a library global value. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the node and returns zero.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:010C
name: set_node_flag_bit_three
description: Sets bit three of a flag byte in a library node and returns zero.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:0116
name: acquire_library_node_use
description: If a flag bit in a library node is clear, it increments the node's use counter and, on the first use, makes a library vector call. It returns the node when the flag is clear and minus one when the flag bit is set. It references the text mathffp.library.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:0152
name: release_library_use_counter
description: Decrements a library node's use counter. When it reaches zero and the flag bit is set, it calls another routine, and when it reaches zero it makes a library vector call with a saved value. It returns the result of the nested call or zero.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:019C
name: forward_single_call
description: A wrapper in the mathtrans library that calls one routine and returns.

key: worms (1995)(ocean)(m3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr ott]/Worms (1995)(Ocean)(M3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr OTT].adf:libs/mathtrans.library:0:01A8
name: compute_bitwise_square_root
description: Computes a bit-by-bit square root of an input value over twenty-three steps. Zero input returns at once, and negative input is passed to another routine.
